messages:
maya: Quick sync on internal API surface for inference routing. Proposal: gRPC + protobufs inside the cluster, tiny JSON gateway at edge for external clients.
jc: gRPC for S2S 👍. Concern: console + partners need simple JSON. Do we transcode or generate JSON shims?
taylor: If gateway transcodes, ensure telemetry headers and quota attributes are preserved. Envoy's mapping can drop metadata.
nina: Proto-first OK. Watch streaming and PATCH semantics. Suggest google.api.http annotations to keep mapping explicit.
maya: We can keep streaming for long-poll/job status as separate HTTP endpoints. Main control plane is unary RPCs.
jc: Minimal gateway that only transpiles JSON->gRPC and validates schema seems ideal. Version the gateway API.
taylor: Metrics needed: route_key (service.method), model_variant, route_policy, latency_ms, error_count, quota_check_latency. Console needs per-route and per-model breakdowns.
sam: Rollouts: console should support canary percent, start ts, p50/p95, error threshold and one-click rollback. Default canary 5% for 24h.
nina: Linter rule: all protos must include google.api.http and examples. Gateway should reject unknown JSON fields to avoid silent loss.
maya: Header plan: gateway adds x-rdwd-route and x-rdwd-tenant, passed as gRPC metadata. If missing, fallback to token introspection and emit a metric.
jc: Auth: gateway validates JWT and exchanges for internal short-lived token. Services accept internal token only.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: maya pushed proto-gateway branch to staging at 4960001333 :rocket:
sam: Rollout plan: 1) schema freeze, 2) gateway in staging with strict validation, 3) enable telemetry headers and tracing, 4) quota integration tests, 5) 5% canary->monitor->ramp.
maya: Action items: jc write gateway design doc by Wed EOD; nina add proto linter; taylor build dashboard mockups; sam draft canary thresholds and console UX. I'll start a separate thread for long-poll mapping.
